name: centaur
skin_color: Bronzed human skin / various horse coats
special_features: Humanoid upper body, equine lower body
lore:
Centaurs are the sovereign architects of the wild, a seamless fusion of human intellect and equine majesty. From the waist up, they possess the powerful build of a seasoned warrior; below, the formidable body of a stallion. Their skin is often bronzed by the sun, their manes and hair braided with feathers or river-stones, and their eyes carry the depth of the horizon itself. They move with a fluid grace that belies their massive weight, capable of crossing leagues of rugged terrain with tireless endurance.

Their origins are shrouded in the mists of the First Age. Some chronicles suggest they were birthed from the union of the Great Wind and the Earth Mother, while others claim they were a divine experiment to bridge the gap between civilization and the untamed world. Regardless of their making, they remain intrinsically tied to the land’s pulse, acting as the self-appointed guardians of the green spaces.

Centaurs are a nomadic and profoundly spiritual people. They shun the stifling walls of cities, preferring the infinite canopy of the sky. To a centaur, the stars are a living map—a celestial ledger of past heroes and future omens. Tribal life is governed by a strict code of honor and hospitality; they are generous hosts but terrifying foes if their ancestral grazing lands are defiled. They excel in the arts of archery, herbalism, and song, viewing the hunt not merely as a means of survival, but as a sacred dance. To earn the trust of a centaur is to gain a companion who remembers every oath and every slight for generations. Tread lightly in their meadows, traveler, for you walk upon their cathedral.
